a.lede: For those looking to ditch cloud storage this Black Friday, UGreen's DXP4800 GT 4-bay NAS enclosure has gone on sale with a lovely 20% discount at Amazon, marking the second time it's returned to its all-time low price point.
a.title: Ditch cloud subscriptions with a $132 discount on a 4-Bay UGreen DXP4800 GT NAS enclosure in Amazon Black Friday deal — offers dual 10GbE ports and supports up to 144TB of storage

b.lede: SanDisk's large 512 GB MicroSD Express card has dropped to just $98 at Amazon, marking a 24% discount when compared to its original list price in a rare storage offer.
b.title: SanDisk 512GB MicroSD Express deal slashes Switch 2 storage by 24% in Amazon Black Friday offer — price hits under $100 amid storage squeeze
